request.text: A colossal four-winged alien flexes its chest. Heavy soft leathery wingbeats offset in pairs, low resonant nasal growl, slow tendon creaks and fine breathy membrane flutter. Menacing graceful wild animal, detailed cinematic organic Foley. No screech, jump scare, human voice, music, weapons or alarm.

An ancient fossil-armored sea drake exhales. Deep hoarse chest breath, worn bony plates grinding softly over muscle, horn cartilage groans and a broad leathery tail sweep ending in a low rasp. Huge ominous living creature, rich physical cinematic Foley. No human voice, roaring jump scare, music, falling rubble, weapon or alarm.

A giant opal scallop slowly closes and opens its shell. Hollow rounded suction breath, two soft mineral valve creaks, a fine flutter of many mantle cilia and gentle watery chamber resonance fading away. Exquisite strange living shellfish, detailed cinematic Foley. No musical chime, melody, voice, impact crash, weapon or alarm.

One immense three-throated alien breathes with three staggered organic voices. Low chest rumble, one husky nasal exhale, a softer hollow gill murmur answering it, slow neck tendon creaks and wide membrane folds. Beautiful ominous living creature with coherent shared body, cinematic Foley. No words, singing, music, scream, weapon or alarm.

An enormous soft velvet worm swims in a slow rolling wave. Quiet fleshy segments compress, many fringed paddles brush softly in sequence, low warm hollow breathing and small damp mouth clicks fade into a tail swish. Uncanny gentle giant, highly textured cinematic organic Foley. No music, voice, cute squeak, slithering horror sting, weapon or alarm.

A giant antler-crowned aquatic alien calls once. Low resonant nasal breath opening into a soft hollow bone-chamber overtone, fine sensory crown creaks, broad membrane fin sweeps and a long calm exhale. Ancient regal eerie living animal, detailed cinematic Foley. No stag bugle, human voice, choir, music, weapon or alarm.

A colossal icy armored isopod shifts its plates. Soft staggered crystalline shell creaks over a low breathing rasp, many translucent paddle feet moving with muted wet ticks, gentle antenna friction and a short hollow exhale. Heavy beautiful alien crustacean, cinematic organic Foley. No ice explosion, machinery, music, voice, weapon or alarm.

An enormous amber-winged alien glides slowly. Fine dry membrane wing sweeps in two offset pairs, warm low thoracic purr, delicate antenna ticks and a soft airy resonant flutter fading into silence. Beautiful immense living insect, cinematic organic Foley. No magical chimes, melody, music, human voice, fire, weapons or alarm.

An immense lantern angler breathes through a cavernous jaw. Deep hollow suction growl, long damp gill rasp, soft lure-stalk tendon creaks and a tiny organic lantern pulse beneath a heavy rounded exhale. Dangerous ancient animal, detailed cinematic creature Foley. No sonar beep, electrical zap, scream, music, human voice, weapon or alarm.

A colossal translucent octopus pulses its mantle. Deep rounded liquid lung pressure, eight heavy smooth arms sliding past with soft suction clicks, a delicate irregular internal tremor and a long airy wet sigh. Beautiful unnerving living animal, richly textured cinematic Foley. No glass crash, bells, music, words, weapon or alarm.
